descripcion_geo: Mountain ridge east of Jerusalem separated from the Temple Mount by the Kidron Valley. Covered with olive groves since ancient times.
importancia_estrategica: Holy place for Judaism (scene of Zechariah's prophecy) and the center of the last days of Jesus in Jerusalem.

historias.titulo: David flees through the Mount of Olives
historias.descripcion: David ascends the Mount of Olives crying barefoot when fleeing the rebellion of his son Absalom.

historias.titulo: Ezekiel sees the Glory leave the Temple
historias.descripcion: The Glory of God leaves the Temple of Jerusalem and stops on the Mount of Olives.
Zechariah prophesies that on the day of the Lord his feet will rest on the Mount of Olives and it will split in two.

personajes.rol: King of Israel on the run
personajes.descripcion: He ascended the Mount of Olives weeping as he fled from Absalom; symbol of passion by Jesus.
He saw the Glory of God rest on the mountain before Jerusalem was destroyed.
He prophesied that the Messiah will rest on the Mount of Olives on the final day.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Sacred mountain between Jerusalem and the desert; scene of messianic prophecies and the final drama of Jesus's life.

judaismo.descripcion: The Glory of God stopped on the mountain when leaving the Temple (Ez 11:23); there he will return at the end (Zech 14:4).
judaismo.significado_teologico: The Glory of God stopped on the mountain when leaving the Temple (Ez 11:23); there he will return at the end (Zech 14:4).

cristianismo.descripcion: Jesus ascended to heaven from the Mount of Olives (Acts 1:9-12); The angels promised that he will return in the same way.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: Jesus ascended to heaven from the Mount of Olives (Acts 1:9-12); The angels promised that he will return in the same way.

historias.titulo: The triumphal entry from the Mount of Olives
historias.descripcion: Jesus descends the Mount of Olives on a donkey amidst cheers from the crowd; Zechariah 9:9 is fulfilled.

historias.titulo: The eschatological discourse on the Mount of Olives
historias.descripcion: Sitting on the mount in front of the Temple, Jesus announces the destruction of Jerusalem and the signs of the end.

historias.titulo: Gethsemane: the agony in the garden
historias.descripcion: In the garden at the foot of the Mount of Olives, Jesus prays until he sweats blood before being arrested.

personajes.descripcion: He prayed, taught and was arrested on the Mount of Olives; He ascended to heaven from there.
He slept in Gethsemane and cut off the servant's ear when he was arrested Jesus.
He knew the orchard and led the mob to the arrest of Jesus.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: The Mount of Olives was the central stage of the passion, eschatological discourse and ascension of Jesus.

mitos.nombre: The mountain of passion and ascension

cristianismo.descripcion: The Mount of Olives fulfills Zechariah's prophecy: the Messiah descends in triumph and ascends in glory from there.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: The Mount of Olives fulfills Zechariah's prophecy: the Messiah descends in triumph and ascends in glory from there.
